final_user_goal: Start the genuine prospective First60 experiment without backfill, sample substitution, or reconstruction of strategy logic.
hard_constraints: First60 consists of the earliest 60 eligible Episode starts after the new activation boundary, not 60 securities.
Episode ranks 1-30 are Stage A; ranks 31-60 are Stage B; ALL60 is exactly A union B and A/B are non-overlapping.
Missing or unavailable outcomes are never replaced by Episode 61+.
Same-symbol Episode starts are suppressed until the existing Episode ends.
Target T is frozen at Episode start as D+10 joint A-share trading sessions; missing T bar is OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE and T is not shifted.
Only post-activation signal dates may append; Shadow/Development/pre-activation observations are permanently excluded.
Signal-date retained source must prove max_bar_date == D; stale D-1 snapshots are blocked.
Zero-candidate sessions inside the covered prospective interval must still be recorded.
First60 temporal sufficiency: ALL60 >=10 distinct signal dates; Stage A >=5; Stage B >=5; no one date >20% of ALL60. Failure is INCONCLUSIVE, not strategy FAIL.
Episode start must be inside the V2.7.31 Forward Certified Universe effective for that signal date.
Outcome and economic-price semantics remain inherited/frozen; ledger code may not redefine them.
soft_constraints_removed: recreate TQ/Setup strategy rules from memory
pre-materialize every issuer PDF before First60 can start

architecture.Delete: No backfill and no synthetic Episode generation.
architecture.Avoid: Ledger admission is separated from signal production.
architecture.Absorb: V2.7.31 Certified Universe and V2.7.30 materialization contracts remain upstream authorities.
architecture.Substitute: Rebuild only a strategy-agnostic append-only ledger gate because legacy runtime code is absent from GitHub.
architecture.Precompute_Reuse: Freeze the actual 2026 joint A-share calendar once and reuse its hash.
architecture.Optimize: Only after correctness and append-only invariants pass.
